name: Debug Push Permissions

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - '**'  # Run on all branches

jobs:
  debug:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Log environment details
        env:
          GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          GITHUB_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          GITHUB_REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          GITHUB_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
          GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          GITHUB_ACTOR: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: |
          echo "=== Environment Variables ==="
          env | sort
          echo "=== GitHub Context ==="
          echo "Repository: $GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          echo "Ref: $GITHUB_REF"
          echo "Ref Name: $GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          echo "Event: $GITHUB_EVENT_NAME"
          echo "Workflow: $GITHUB_WORKFLOW"
          echo "Run ID: $GITHUB_RUN_ID"
          echo "Run Number: $GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER"
          echo "Actor: $GITHUB_ACTOR"

      - name: Check authentication status
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "=== Authentication Status ==="
          AUTH_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/user)
          echo "$AUTH_RESPONSE"

      - name: Get branch protection rules
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          GITHUB_REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          echo "=== Branch Protection Rules for $GITHUB_REF_NAME ==="
          PROTECTION_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/branches/$GITHUB_REF_NAME/protection)
          echo "$PROTECTION_RESPONSE"
